newsitem.title: CHINA: Granny in coma saved from Chinese crematorium.
newsitem.headline: Granny in coma saved from Chinese crematorium.

text.p: A 93-year-old Chinese woman, mistakenly presumed dead, was rescued from cremation at a mortuary in Guangzhou in southern China's Guangdong province, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
The woman's family sent her body to the mortuary after she fell into a coma and they thought she was dead, Xinhua said.
"That evening, when a mortuary worker tried to tie an identification tag to Li's hand, he felt her move and realised she was breathing," it said.
Doctors summoned to the scene found the elderly woman alive but suffering from low blood pressure brought on by diabetes, it said. The woman was in hospital and her condition was improving.
